title: Is my game too weird?
author: s00pr
selftext:
Walk an endless road, generated music made by your followers and gather a parade.

It all started in earlier projects I noticed how AI and Godot generated sounds for me. So I figured lets try some music. Later I started generate these followers aswell. Some premade assets were used but im thinking of generating everything further along. The encore function got added as a game mechanic so it wouldn’t only be a long road..

Assets from Gandalfhardcore  
32rogues

I hope someone could try it and leave some comments :)
